description: User taps a post title to open its detail/comments view
User opens an external URL from a post in the feed list
User taps the upvote button on a post in the feed list
User taps the comment count button on a post to open its discussion
User scrolls to end of feed, triggering the next page of posts
User selects a different story feed type (top, best, ask, show)
User taps an author's name to open their profile
User taps the upvote button on an item's detail page
User opens the external URL linked from an item's detail page
User taps the 'Commented on' card to navigate to the parent item
User scrolls to end of comments, loading the next page
User scrolls to end of a user's activity feed, loading the next page
